purpose: Author-facing rules for CUTSCENE_SCRIPT_V1 only. Backend/internal rules are intentionally omitted.

rules.instruction: Use only values published in this CURRENT pack. Absence from CURRENT means unavailable; never infer a handle or identity.
For locationHandle, visible.handle, effectHandle, viaHandle and audio.handle use an exact Simple V1 authoring handle. Never serialize a raw Catalog asset ID.
Author animation/performance as animationIntent or performanceIntent only. Never serialize a raw animation asset ID in CUTSCENE_SCRIPT_V1; Unity resolves compatibility.
Every dialogue speaker/listener must be an authoringReady actorId from EMOTIONAL_DIALOGUE_CURRENT.json and match cast[].id exactly.
For dialogue cast, cast[].identityHandle must exactly equal that character's published identityHandle. Do not substitute Actor/UI/Atlas/portrait handles.

expressionIntent, when present, must exactly match a supported expression for that speaker. Omit expressionIntent to request the published defaultExpression. Never write null and never fall back to Neutral.
Do not combine locked portrait dialogue with explicit world movement for the same participant in the same beat. Put world movement in a separate beat when needed.
A cast participant has one narrative identity and at most one optional presentationHandle. presentationHandle never creates or changes identity.
Before selecting a visual handle, inspect its Atlas pixels. Metadata alone is not visual proof.

Do not author V3/V5 bookkeeping such as lifetime ownership, mechanical IDs, fixed Dialogue Stage mechanics, project font defaults, deterministic scale defaults, or raw presentation modes. Those are backend-owned unless represented by a Simple V1 field.
Serialize only fields defined by CUTSCENE_SCRIPT_V1.schema.json. Do not invent noncanonical fields.
